title: Commit & Push (Damien Filiatrault, Scalable Path CEO) — Eric: 'It's always too early until it's too late.'
summary: Damien Filiatrault — CEO of Scalable Path — runs an Incorruptible-week episode of Commit & Push framing the book around the founder's natural assumption that governance, ownership, and mission protection are problems for later.
